test_cases.objective: Splash CTA tab navigates to legal acceptance

test_cases.actual_result: Only 'Tab to proceed' CTA; no skip control rendered
Root is a Pressable; no gesture navigable container
No guest control anywhere in onboarding

test_cases.problem_found: BackHandler only in index.tsx wrapper; second splash had no handler
test_cases.fix_made: BackHandler centralized into OnboardingScreen via useFocusEffect; app/splash.tsx deleted
test_cases.expected_result: Back on splash is swallowed; app stays open
test_cases.actual_result: Code attaches hardwareBackPress handler returning true on focus; OS-level behavior not executed in this session

test_cases.objective: Protected deep links cannot reach screens early
test_cases.problem_found: Flat unguarded Stack exposed every route (otp-entry, profile-setup, device-handoff, (tabs))
test_cases.expected_result: Direct deep link bounces to splash anchor
test_cases.actual_result: Guards present for otp-entry/profile-setup/device-handoff/(tabs); real deep-link open not executed
test_cases.evidence: CODE: app/_layout.tsx guard blocks. DEVICE: not executed

test_cases.objective: Fabricated phone deep link to /device-handoff rejected
test_cases.fix_made: isValidPhoneNumber (libphonenumber-js/mobile) + '+' prefix check before handoff logic
test_cases.actual_result: Validation logic rejects non-E.164 inputs; fabricated-number link not opened on device

test_cases.objective: Different fabricated phone number also rejected
test_cases.fix_made: Same format-based guard as TC-07 covers all fabrications
test_cases.expected_result: Any fake number redirected to splash
test_cases.actual_result: Validation is format-based (libphonenumber-js) so covers arbitrary inputs; not executed on device

test_cases.problem_found: profile-setup was public; no otpVerified state consulted
test_cases.fix_made: profile-setup + device-handoff wrapped in Stack.Protected guard=otpVerified; otp-entry sets markOtpVerified() on success
test_cases.actual_result: Guard present; direct-link opening not executed on device
test_cases.evidence: CODE: _layout.tsx guard + otp-entry.tsx markOtpVerified(). DEVICE: not executed

test_cases.objective: Cold start / cleared state blocks protected deep links
test_cases.problem_found: No onboarding state existed, so cleared state was indistinguishable from unlocked
test_cases.fix_made: OnboardingContext flags are in-memory only, all default false (INITIAL_STATE), never persisted
test_cases.expected_result: Cleared data / cold start -> all deep links bounce to splash
test_cases.actual_result: State design guarantees false defaults on cold start; cleared-state run not executed
test_cases.evidence: CODE: hooks/OnboardingContext.tsx INITIAL_STATE. DEVICE: not executed

test_cases.problem_found: Duplicate splash route app/splash.tsx auto-registered, no BackHandler, no guard
test_cases.fix_made: app/splash.tsx deleted (-356 lines); splash consolidated into OnboardingScreen.tsx (anchor)
test_cases.actual_result: File absent from app/; no /splash route can register
test_cases.evidence: Commit 6b1133b deletes app/splash.tsx; Test-Path False on app/splash.tsx
